import json, sys
saved = sys._shield_banner_geometry_r20
states = [('large_front', 0., 0., 4.), ('large_yaw45', 45., 15., 4.),
          ('large_back', 180., 0., 4.)]
assert saved['step'] < len(states)
label, yaw, pitch, scale = states[saved['step']]
results = []
for row in saved['controls']:
    params = {'block_geometry_model_name': row['model'], 'scale': scale,
              'init_rot_x': -90. + pitch, 'init_rot_y': 0., 'init_rot_z': yaw}
    returned = row['doll'].RenderBlockGeometryModel(params)
    assert returned
    results.append({'label': row['label'], 'params': params, 'returned': returned})
saved['step'] += 1
saved['last_label'] = label
_result = json.dumps({'label': label, 'step': saved['step'], 'results': results})
